public class Ideone {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        String a = sc.next();
        boolean paren = false;
        int max = 0;
        int cnt = 0;
        int temp = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (a.charAt(i) == '_') {
                if (paren && temp != 0) {
                    cnt++;
                    temp = 0;
                } else {
                    if (temp > max)
                        max = temp;
                    temp = 0;
                }
            } else if (a.charAt(i) == '(') {
                paren = true;
                if (temp > max)
                    max = temp;
                temp = 0;
            } else if (a.charAt(i) == ')') {
                paren = false;
                if (temp > 0) {
                    cnt++;
                    temp = 0;
                }
            } else {
                temp++;
            }
        }
        if (temp > max)
            max = temp;

        System.out.println(max + " " + cnt);
    }
}
